answer: Each identity claims one canyon raven roost and locks an 80-credit bond. Each epoch it files dawn and dusk counts; the delta between them must fit that canyon roost table. An auditor recomputes the delta, burning the bond on a mismatch over 3 percent, a reused count, or a double claim. The first filing costs 34, the kth 34+7(k-1), so the 1000th costs 7027 and 1000 fakes cost 3,530,500 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-roost ring fails because one rented key cannot file two dawn-dusk pairs without reusing a count. An honest agent files one raven roost once for 34 and gets the bond back.
